Message From Principal's Desk
A society, organization, institution, or person always bears some limitations.We too have limitations, yet we have been shouldering our responsibilities since the year 1993 to fruition the unlimited expectations that have been among the masses of Morigaon with limited resources. The job is painstaking. The institution has reached this stage after the auspicious blessedness of the Baruah family particularly of Late Khirod Baruah and Mrs. Jonjonali Baruah and we too have enjoyed the happiness of sacrificial social work. Numbers of social workers, students, and their guardians have been continuously coming and sharing with us. The pouring of blessings of their heart has been moistening the field of Ghanakanta Baruah College. We hope this will remain alive. Students are social wealth and human resources. Our job is to transform them into human capital. We are committed to better posterity. Their industriousness and ability in the practical field reflect how valued capital we have produced. The success and industriousness of our students for the positive framework of society is our dividend. Nothing can embank the joy of a teacher on the success of their student like Narayan Konwar’s one. We hope for such joy again and again.
Presently the Generosity and Enthusiasm of the Government are proving a great asset for the college practically in fostering the development of the college.
